selected_title.en: Start with the work, then the stack.

selected_heading.zh: 五個代表專案涵蓋工程資料與 AI、多人 Web、活動現場營運、商業 CMS，以及伺服器權威的即時多人遊戲。
selected_heading.en: Five selected projects spanning engineering data and AI, multiplayer web, field operations, a maintainable business CMS, and a server-authoritative real-time game.

additional_title.zh: 可靠的 AI 自動化，不只是一條生成鏈。
additional_title.en: Reliable AI automation is more than a generation chain.

additional_heading.zh: 將來源、去重、人工審核模式、失敗恢復、發布狀態與通知納入同一條營運流程。
additional_heading.en: Source ingestion, deduplication, review controls, recovery, publish state and notifications are treated as one operational workflow.

title.zh: 浮標資料分析與航道風險評估平台

card_description.zh: 資料 QA、LSTM 預測、模型驗證、快取、風險門檻與輸出下載整合成 Streamlit 分析流程。
card_description.en: Data QA, LSTM forecasting, validation, model caching, risk thresholds and downloadable outputs in Streamlit.

image_alt.zh: 浮標資料分析平台功能預覽

role.zh: 資料與 ML 流程開發

scope.zh: Data QA · LSTM · 風險規則 · Streamlit
scope.en: Data QA · LSTM · risk rules · Streamlit

problem.zh: 海洋觀測資料需要先處理品質、缺值與時間尺度，模型結果也必須轉成可判讀的風險訊號。
problem.en: Marine observations need QA, missing-data handling and time-scale normalization before model output can become an interpretable risk signal.

decision.zh: 把 resample、缺值策略、模型驗證、cache、風險門檻與 export 串成同一條分析流程。
decision.en: Connect resampling, missing-data strategies, validation, caching, risk thresholds and exports in one analysis workflow.

evidence.zh: Repository 可核對 5 種時間尺度、4 種缺值策略與 4 種輸出；不把未固定資料集的模型分數包裝成成果。
evidence.en: The repository verifies 5 time scales, 4 missing-data strategies and 4 exports; model scores without a fixed benchmark are not presented as performance claims.

next.zh: 下一步是固定 benchmark 資料集、加入 baseline / model comparison，並把資料來源與驗證流程再自動化。
next.en: Next: establish a fixed benchmark dataset, add baseline/model comparisons and automate more of the data/validation pipeline.

title.zh: 楚河棋局｜線上中國象棋

card_description.zh: 6 碼房間、標準象棋與揭棋、AI、悔棋、回放與 revision 同步，房間狀態落到資料庫。
card_description.en: Cross-device rooms with two rule modes, AI, undo/replay and revision-based database synchronization.

role.zh: 全端 Web 產品開發

scope.zh: 棋規 · 多人房間 · 狀態同步 · Persistence
scope.en: Game rules · multiplayer rooms · state sync · persistence

case_facts.stack: JavaScript · HTTP API · Neon Postgres / D1

problem.zh: 多人棋局除了規則正確，還要避免不同裝置的舊狀態覆蓋新棋局，並處理重連與房間生命週期。
problem.en: A multiplayer board game must prevent stale cross-device state from overwriting newer moves while handling reconnects and room lifecycle.

decision.zh: 使用 revision + polling、player token、heartbeat 與持久化房間 state，把 UI 規則與多人同步分層。
decision.en: Use revision-based polling, player tokens, heartbeats and persisted room state to separate UI rules from multiplayer synchronization.

evidence.zh: 可核對 6 碼房間、2 種主要棋規、Neon Postgres / Cloudflare D1 兩種資料庫後端，並有公開 Live Demo。
evidence.en: Verified features include 6-digit rooms, 2 primary rule modes, Neon Postgres / Cloudflare D1 backends and a public live demo.

next.zh: 下一步是抽出共用 game engine、補自動化規則測試，並讓 server 成為規則權威來源。
next.en: Next: extract a shared game engine, add automated rule tests and make the server authoritative for game rules.

title.zh: 活動報到與現場營運系統

card_description.zh: 結合 QR 報到、即時簽到與入席統計、名單篩選、座位與現場例外處理的全端活動營運工具。
card_description.en: A full-stack workflow connecting QR check-in, live attendance and seating metrics, operational filters and on-site exception handling.

image_alt.zh: 活動報到與現場營運系統公開 Demo
image_alt.en: Event check-in and operations public demo

role.zh: 全端現場營運工具開發

scope.zh: QR 報到 · 即時統計 · 篩選 · 座位
scope.en: QR check-in · live metrics · filters · seating

status.zh: 正式系統 + 隱私安全公開 Demo

problem.zh: 活動現場需要在有限時間內完成報到、搜尋、篩選、座位確認與例外處理，而且操作狀態必須快速回饋。
problem.en: On-site operations need fast check-in, search, filtering, seating confirmation and exception handling with immediate feedback.

decision.zh: 以 Next.js API → D1 → Drizzle 串接資料層，搭配 QR、30 秒統計更新與多維篩選支援現場操作。
decision.en: Use Next.js API → D1 → Drizzle for the data path, with QR workflows, 30-second metric refreshes and multi-dimensional filters.

evidence.zh: 目前可核對 30 秒更新、5 維篩選、預先報名 / 現場兩種名單來源與 CSV export；公開 Demo 僅使用 24 筆虛構資料。
evidence.en: Verified behavior includes 30-second refreshes, 5 filter dimensions, preregistration/onsite sources and CSV export; the public demo uses only 24 synthetic records.

next.zh: 多活動、正式帳號 / RBAC、audit log、idempotency、多裝置衝突與 offline queue 都明確列為未來升級，不宣稱已完成。
next.en: Multi-event support, real accounts/RBAC, audit logs, idempotency, multi-device conflict handling and an offline queue remain explicitly future work.

title.zh: 股東紀念品服務與 CMS 平台

card_description.zh: 整合公開服務網站、商品與公告後台、Supabase 認證、PostgreSQL 與雲端圖片儲存的商業網站。
card_description.en: A maintainable service website with product and announcement CMS, Supabase authentication, PostgreSQL and cloud image storage.

image_alt.zh: 股東紀念品服務網站公開首頁預覽
image_alt.en: Shareholder Gift Service public homepage preview

alt.zh: 股東紀念品服務網站公開首頁預覽
alt.en: Shareholder Gift Service public homepage preview

caption.zh: Portfolio 優先擷取 sharegift.tw 的公開首頁作為作品預覽；若公開站暫時無法擷取，才回退至已審核的架構圖。建置流程不會存取需要登入的管理後台。
caption.en: The portfolio prefers a build-time capture of the public sharegift.tw homepage; if the public site cannot be captured, it falls back to the reviewed architecture visual. The build never accesses authenticated admin pages.

scope.zh: 公開網站 · CMS · Auth / RLS · Storage
scope.en: Public site · CMS · Auth / RLS · Storage

problem.zh: 商業服務網站的商品與公告若每次都靠修改程式發布，內容維護成本會快速增加。
problem.en: A service website becomes costly to maintain when every product or announcement update requires a code change and redeploy.

decision.zh: 用 Vue 3 / TypeScript 建公開站與 CMS，Supabase 提供 Email Auth、PostgreSQL、Storage 與 RLS 資料存取控制。
decision.en: Use Vue 3 / TypeScript for the public site and CMS, with Supabase Email Auth, PostgreSQL, Storage and RLS-backed data access.

evidence.zh: 目前可核對商品 / 公告 2 條主要 CMS 流程、Auth / Database / Storage 3 種 Supabase 能力、9 種 Schema.org type 與 GitHub Actions CI/CD。
evidence.en: Verified scope includes 2 primary CMS flows, 3 Supabase capabilities (Auth/Database/Storage), 9 Schema.org types and GitHub Actions CI/CD.

next.zh: 下一步可強化後台操作稽核、內容版本紀錄與更完整的管理端流程；目前 Portfolio 不宣稱這些已存在。
next.en: Next improvements could add admin auditability, content revision history and richer management workflows; the portfolio does not claim these exist today.

title.zh: Neon Arena｜即時多人德州撲克

card_description.zh: 2–6 人即時牌局，以 Cloudflare Durable Objects 維持伺服器權威狀態、私牌隔離、18 秒回合、斷線重連與主池／邊池結算。
card_description.en: A 2–6 player real-time table using Cloudflare Durable Objects for server-authoritative state, private-card isolation, 18-second turns, reconnects and main/side-pot settlement.

image_alt.zh: Neon Arena 即時多人德州撲克公開 Demo
image_alt.en: Neon Arena real-time multiplayer Hold'em public demo

alt.zh: Neon Arena 即時多人德州撲克公開 Demo
alt.en: Neon Arena real-time multiplayer Hold'em public demo

caption.zh: Portfolio 優先擷取公開 Neon Arena Demo 作為作品預覽；若外站暫時無法擷取，才回退至已審核的霓虹牌桌 visual。Demo 僅使用虛擬籌碼，沒有付費、儲值或兌現。
caption.en: The portfolio prefers a capture of the public Neon Arena demo and falls back to the reviewed neon-table visual when the public site cannot be captured. The demo uses virtual chips only, with no payments, deposits or cash-out.

role.zh: 全端即時多人遊戲開發

scope.zh: 牌局規則 · WebSocket · Durable Objects · Reconnect
scope.en: Game rules · WebSocket · Durable Objects · reconnect

case_facts.stack: React · Cloudflare Workers · Durable Objects / SQLite

problem.zh: 即時德州撲克不只要同步桌面，還必須保護私牌、處理同時操作與回合期限、斷線重連，以及多人 all-in 後的牌池結算。
problem.en: Real-time Hold'em must protect hole cards while resolving concurrent actions, turn deadlines, reconnects and multi-player all-in pot settlement.

decision.zh: 採用伺服器權威模型：每房一個 Durable Object，使用 Hibernation WebSocket、SQLite persistence、alarm timeout、玩家個別 snapshot 與 Web Crypto CSPRNG 洗牌。
decision.en: Use a server-authoritative model with one Durable Object per room, Hibernation WebSockets, SQLite persistence, alarm-based turn timeouts, per-player snapshots and Web Crypto CSPRNG shuffling.

evidence.zh: 目前已實作 2–6 位同桌、18 秒回合、進行中加入先觀戰、斷線重連、房主轉移、主池／邊池與退款結算；公開 Live Demo 僅使用虛擬籌碼。
evidence.en: Implemented behavior includes 2–6 players, 18-second turns, mid-hand observers, reconnects, host transfer, main/side pots and refunds; the public live demo uses virtual chips only.

next.zh: 下一步是玩家可驗證的 commit/reveal 公平性、正式帳號與跨裝置身分恢復、觀眾模式，以及席位到期回收。
next.en: Next: player-verifiable commit/reveal fairness, real accounts with cross-device identity recovery, spectator mode and seat-expiry reclamation.

card_description.zh: 以 MoneyPrinterTurbo 為生成核心，新增四條內容線、RSS 選題與去重、LLM／本機評分 fallback、pending upload 恢復、多平台介面、job 紀錄、日報與通知。
card_description.en: Built around MoneyPrinterTurbo with four editorial profiles, RSS selection and deduplication, LLM/local scoring fallback, pending-upload recovery, multi-platform adapters, job records, daily reports and alerts.

image_alt.zh: Reliable AI Media Automation Pipeline 架構圖
image_alt.en: Reliable AI Media Automation Pipeline architecture

note.zh: Portfolio 明確區分上游框架與自行新增的自動化／營運層，不把既有生成引擎宣稱為從零實作。
note.en: The portfolio separates the upstream generation framework from the automation and operations layer added around it.

scope.zh: RSS · 去重 · fallback · 發布恢復 · 通知
scope.en: RSS · dedupe · fallback · publish recovery · alerts

problem.zh: 自動生成流程真正的營運風險不只在生成品質，還包含重複來源、選題失敗、發布中斷與失敗後無法追蹤。
problem.en: Operational risk in an automated media pipeline includes duplicate sources, selection failure, interrupted publishing and poor failure traceability—not only generation quality.

decision.zh: 在上游 MoneyPrinterTurbo 外新增 RSS intake / dedupe、LLM→本機評分 fallback、pending upload recovery、job JSON、日報與通知。
decision.en: Add RSS intake/deduplication, LLM→local-scoring fallback, pending-upload recovery, job JSON records, daily reports and notifications around the upstream MoneyPrinterTurbo engine.

evidence.zh: 目前可核對 4 條內容線、3 個發布平台介面、2 個通知通道，以及 `--dry-run` / `--no-upload` / manual review 3 種安全執行控制。
evidence.en: Verified scope includes 4 content profiles, 3 publishing platform interfaces, 2 notification channels and 3 execution controls: `--dry-run`, `--no-upload` and manual review.

next.zh: 設定中已有品質門檻欄位，但主流程目前沒有把它強制成 publish blocker；下一步才是把 quality gate 真正接進發布決策。
next.en: Quality-threshold fields exist in configuration, but the main flow does not currently enforce them as a publish blocker; wiring that gate into publish decisions is future work.
